besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('n Woltrui het ... / 'n brood het ...).
besluite.rede: Correct AWS 2017 comma; meaning and the protected 'n Woltrui are untouched.

besluite.fout: The repeated 'en' in a three-item list reads clumsily.
besluite.rede: A plain list with a comma is the natural form and changes nothing in meaning.

besluite.fout: Without a comma the fronted object phrase runs into the main verb ('gebruik noem'), which makes the reader stumble.
besluite.rede: The comma marks where the long fronted phrase ends; this is study text, not the glossary definition.
'iemand by 'n kraan' already reads naturally; the proposal adds an action and length without a clear gain.

besluite.fout: 'gestrik' disagrees with the sub-topic's other lesson, which says 'gebrei' for the same jersey; 'brei' is also the standard verb.
besluite.rede: Decided HOU by a person so that the two lessons agree.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('n Meule maal ... / 'n bakker bak ...).
The subjectless passive 'waarmee begin is' is wooden.
besluite.rede: 'waarmee alles begin het' is what a fluent writer would say and keeps the same meaning.

besluite.fout: The comparison lacks its second term ('as waar'), 'ver moes kom' is loose, and the fronted relative clause has no comma.
besluite.rede: 'van ver af', 'as daar waar' and the comma fix real faults without moving the meaning; the protected sentence before it is untouched.
The indefinite 'n oes reads well as a general condition; the definite article is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: After 'Was ..., dan is daar ...' the coordinated consequence keeps straight order, which loosens its link to the condition.
besluite.rede: Inverted 'en styg die waarde' keeps both clauses under 'dan', so the rise is clearly a result of the poor harvest.
